origin.description: Check a package MD5 file against the files on disk.

arguments.name: package
arguments.text: Package name, used to find the directory when dir is missing.

arguments.name: dir
arguments.text: Directory that contains the MD5 file.

origin.details: Returns NA when the directory or the MD5 file is missing. Otherwise TRUE, or FALSE after printing the missing files and the files whose digest differs. Quotes are the Unicode single quotes R's sQuote uses.
origin.example: dir <- tempfile(); dir.create(dir); writeLines("hello", file.path(dir, "a.txt")); checkMD5sums(dir=dir)

translation.description: Check a package MD5 file against the files on disk.

arguments.name: package
arguments.text: Package name, used to find the directory when dir is missing.

arguments.name: dir
arguments.text: Directory that contains the MD5 file.

translation.details: The digest is hashlib, the same one md5sum uses. A missing MD5 file returns None.
translation.example:
import os, tempfile
from tools import check_md5sums
directory = tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(os.path.join(directory, "a.txt"), "w").write("hello\n")
print(check_md5sums(directory=directory))
